scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @appzex/api && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @appzex/api && npm run lint --workspace @appzex/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @appzex/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @appzex/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @appzex/api && npm run test --workspace @appzex/web
